assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / compact adaptation. Edit target: the attached advantage icon. Create its TINY UI badge version for 14-24 px display. Keep ONLY ONE d20: the foreground emerald-green die, isolated, centered and enlarged to occupy 90% of a square canvas. REMOVE the rear die completely and REMOVE the cancellation stripe. REPLACE the 20 with ONE LARGE SOLID IVORY UPWARD ARROW on the front face: thick vertical shaft and broad triangular arrowhead, clear UP direction. No numerals or letters anywhere. Preserve the recognizable green d20 silhouette and deep-plum cel-shaded fantasy art identity, but simplify it to just 3-4 broad color planes, thicker clean outer contour and very few interior edges. A wide nearly flat frontal face lets the large ivory arrow dominate. No tiny bevel lines, no decorative detail. Strong silhouette readable at 14 px and 16 px, high contrast arrow on green. Not a UI tile: just one painted fantasy die with an up arrow. No surrounding circle, frame, rear objects, particles, glow, backdrop, floor, shadow outside the die. Genuine TRANSPARENT background with even 5% clear margin. Entire die visible.
